_comment: Model catalog. Adding a model only needs a new entry. languages: list of codes, or "whisper" for every language the tokenizer supports. tier drives the real-time speed warning (tiny/base/small/medium/turbo/large). files: glob patterns to download (default: everything except docs).

models.name: Whisper large-v3-turbo
models.description: Close to large-v3 accuracy and much faster. A good default for real-time captioning on a GPU. (Formerly mobiuslabsgmbh/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo.)

models.name: Taiwan Tongues ASR CE
models.description: Whisper large-v2 fine-tuned for Mandarin, Taiwanese Hokkien, Hakka and English (CTranslate2 inference build). The model has no separate nan/hak language tokens: Hokkien and Hakka are recognised under zh. (Formerly adi-gov-tw/Taiwan-Tongues-ASR-CE.)

models.name: Breeze ASR 25
models.description: Whisper large-v2 fine-tuned by MediaTek Research for Taiwanese Mandarin, English and switching between them mid-sentence. CTranslate2 conversion of MediaTek-Research/Breeze-ASR-25 by SoybeanMilk.

models.name: Whisper base
models.description: Fast; fine for clear speech on the CPU.

models.name: Whisper medium
models.description: More accurate; needs a GPU for comfortable real time.

models.name: Whisper large-v3
models.description: Most accurate Whisper; needs a GPU.
